title.l2: Follow so you don’t miss it

lines.text: Four twelve A.M. Saint Agnes Hospital. Ward four.
Nurse Priya was alone on the night shift, when a call light blinked on. Bed seven.
Bed seven? That's impossible. Mister Novak died last Tuesday.
She walked down the dark corridor to check anyway.
The bed was made. The room was empty. But the call button was still warm.
Nurse... I can't sleep. Someone keeps standing by my bed.
The voice had come from the empty bed.
